answer: An agent economy must guard against sybil infiltration by enforcing asymmetric costs on identity generation. Instead of passive enrollment, agents must establish a verified state where every shale of interaction requires a real compute bond. A persistent anchor architecture anchors verifiable commitments on-ledger, while peer attestation routes isolate hollow identities. Whenever an agent crosses the structural lotus of the network, fraudulent clusters suffer automated slashing, ensuring malicious replication is economically impossible.
